tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream in light, inky purple in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised containers: compose box, tab bar, settings groups, pending thought card, tags on tinted cards.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed controls: mic button, secondary buttons, settings icon tiles, row dividers inside surface groups.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and every type tint.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, snippets, hints, footnotes. Passes 4.5:1 on bg, surface and all five type tints in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet strokes: map noodle links, the dashed border of a thought still being analysed, dashed add-tag button. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The sticker outline (2px) on interactive containers, primary button and selected tab fill, reminder chips, map relation labels.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill.

tokens.name: sticker-shadow
tokens.usage: Colour of the hard 0 4px 0 drop shadow under sticker-style containers.

tokens.name: label-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a full-strength type colour (type pills, map topic and centre nodes). Same in both themes: every type colour passes 5.5:1 or better against it.

tokens.name: idea
tokens.usage: Idea type, full strength: Idea pills, map borders, filter dots. Also the search marker highlight and the reminder switch knob.

tokens.name: idea-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Idea cards, filter chips and map bubbles.

tokens.name: idea-text
tokens.usage: Idea-coloured text on idea-tint or surface (tags, chip labels, relation labels). 6.2:1 on its tint.

tokens.name: project
tokens.usage: Project type, full strength: Project pills, map borders, filter dots, the largest map topic.

tokens.name: project-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Project cards, chips, map bubbles and the thought-detail header of a project.

tokens.name: project-text
tokens.usage: Project-coloured text on project-tint or surface. 6.6:1 on its tint.

tokens.name: todo
tokens.usage: To-do type, full strength: To-do pills, map borders, filter dots. Also the stripe on the empty-bowl illustration.

tokens.name: todo-tint
tokens.usage: Background of To-do cards, chips and map bubbles.

tokens.name: todo-text
tokens.usage: To-do-coloured text on todo-tint or surface. 5:1 on its tint.

tokens.name: memory
tokens.usage: Memory type, full strength: Memory pills, map borders, filter dots.

tokens.name: memory-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Memory cards, chips and map bubbles.

tokens.name: memory-text
tokens.usage: Memory-coloured text on memory-tint or surface. 5.4:1 on its tint.

tokens.name: question
tokens.usage: Question type, full strength: Question pills, map borders, filter dots.

tokens.name: question-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Question cards, chips and map bubbles.

tokens.name: question-text
tokens.usage: Question-coloured text on question-tint or surface. 5.3:1 on its tint.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind search matches. Text on it is always label-ink.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The lowercase wordmark in the Capture header. Always lowercase, always beside the noodle mark.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Top-level screen titles: Search, Map, Settings.

styles.name: detail-title
styles.usage: A thought's title on its detail screen.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Thought titles on cards in lists and search results.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings within a screen: Today, Matching words, Linked thoughts.

styles.name: compose
styles.usage: Text typed into the compose box, and its placeholder.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: An app that reads my bKash SMS and sorts spending by category.
styles.usage: A thought's full text on the detail screen.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Settings rows, linked-thought titles, button labels at 15-16px.

styles.name: snippet
styles.sample: Expires in March. Renew before booking anything abroad.
styles.usage: Thought previews on cards, in muted.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Times, counts, hints and footnotes, in muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Type pills, tags, chips and relation labels.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar and action bar labels under their icons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills and tabs; tab bar item gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills, tags and chips; gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin, card horizontal padding, gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between settings groups and between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space under the floating tab bar, above the home indicator.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and reminder chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons, map thought nodes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Thought cards, compose box, settings groups, reminder card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar and action bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Type pills, filter chips, round icon buttons, map topic bubbles.

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.usage: The hard drop shadow under anything you touch that is a container: compose box, tab bar, settings groups, reminder card, centre map node. Always paired with a 2px ink border.

tokens.name: sticker-small
tokens.usage: The search field's lighter sticker shadow.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Width of the ink sticker outline.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Width of the type-coloured border on map topic bubbles and thought nodes.
